note: Reflex policy pack: terraform. Copy it with `reflex policy init --pack terraform`, then commit .reflex/policy.json. It only adds checks. deny rules block in every mode; ask rules go to a human, and in the autonomous profile never to System 2. Patterns are case-insensitive and read the command plus its context (tf_workspace=, aws_profile=, cwd=). infra: a saved plan that deletes or replaces anything is denied (this is also the default; the pack keeps a user's config from softening it to ask in this repository), and in production an apply without a saved plan is denied instead of asked. The deny needs infra.terraform_show and a provider plugin cache in each teammate's config.json; see the plan-aware terraform gate in docs/GUIDE.md. The prod markers treat a Terraform workspace whose name contains prod as production. Rename them to match your workspaces.

rules.note: deny: state push replaces the shared state file. Recover state by hand, with a backup.

rules.rule: runs Terraform with state locking turned off
rules.note: deny: two runs without a lock can corrupt the state.
deny: the workspace's state goes with it.
ask: these change what Terraform manages without a plan to review.

rules.rule: applies or destroys part of the configuration with -target
rules.note: ask: a targeted run skips dependencies and leaves the rest of the plan unreviewed.

rules.rule: applies or destroys many Terragrunt modules at once
rules.note: ask: one command changes every module under the directory.

always_human.note: never approved by System 2 in the autonomous profile, always a human
